title: US Electric Vehicle Efficiency and Ownership Cost Comparison
scope: Compare currently available U.S. battery-electric vehicle models and trims for model years 2025-2026. Assess EPA efficiency, range, price/incentives, charging costs, maintenance, reliability concerns, recalls, warranty, and 5- and 10-year ownership costs. Use a clearly declared 12,000-mile annual driving baseline and show electricity-price, home/public charging mix, insurance, depreciation, incentive, and ownership-duration sensitivities; leave geography-dependent inputs unknown unless a location is supplied.
exclusions: Do not infer that the most efficient model is the lowest-cost or best vehicle for every driver.
Do not treat search snippets, manufacturer claims, or historical recalls as independently verified current model-year evidence.
Do not estimate a single total cost without stating acquisition, energy, maintenance, depreciation, insurance, tax, incentive, and charging assumptions.
time_period: Model years 2025-2026; ownership horizons of 5 and 10 years from purchase.

terminology.efficiency: EPA combined MPGe and kWh per 100 miles, with test year, model year, trim, and wheel configuration.
terminology.total cost of ownership: Purchase price less eligible incentives plus financing, energy, maintenance/repair, insurance, registration/taxes, charging equipment, and depreciation over an explicitly stated horizon.

efficiency: A vehicle with the highest EPA MPGe also has the lowest estimated owner energy cost in every charging scenario.
total-cost: The most efficient EV is the lowest-total-cost EV for every U.S. buyer.
recalls-warranty: Historical model-family recalls directly predict the current model-year reliability of every trim.

execution_lanes.scope: Identify current U.S. 2025-2026 EV model/trim configurations, EPA MPGe/range, MSRP, and applicable incentive evidence.
execution_lanes.evidence_contract: Primary EPA/DOE vehicle records and dated manufacturer or government price/incentive sources, with exact model-year and trim locators.
execution_lanes.completion_gate: Every compared configuration has source-verified efficiency, range, and price fields or explicit unknowns.

execution_lanes.scope: Gather electricity-price, public charging, maintenance/repair, depreciation, insurance, and cost-model inputs for 5- and 10-year scenarios.
execution_lanes.evidence_contract: Dated government/utility/research data with units, geography, assumptions, and methodology.
execution_lanes.completion_gate: Every computed cost identifies observed inputs, derived calculation, uncertainty, and missing geography-specific values.

execution_lanes.scope: Check model-year-specific recalls, complaints, warranty terms, repair patterns, and source limitations.
execution_lanes.evidence_contract: NHTSA and manufacturer records plus transparently attributed reliability data; recalls are matched to year/trim/VIN scope.
execution_lanes.completion_gate: Known issues are tied to a source and applicable model year; absence of evidence is not presented as absence of defects.

execution_lanes.scope: Reconcile lane evidence, calculate scenario-based costs, challenge rankings, and report conditional recommendations.
execution_lanes.evidence_contract: Claim/evidence-linked comparison table, assumptions, contradictions, sensitivity analysis, objective matrix, and limitations.
execution_lanes.completion_gate: No winner or cost claim is stated without complete, traceable inputs; unresolved objectives remain visible.

objectives.question: Which 2025-2026 U.S. EV model and trim configurations have the highest verified EPA efficiency and useful range?
acceptance_criteria: primary-source model-year and trim-specific EPA MPGe and range

objectives.question: What are the comparable transaction-price ranges and verified incentives for each model/trim and buyer scenario?
acceptance_criteria: dated price evidence by model and trim
eligibility conditions for any included incentive

objectives.question: What are the 5- and 10-year charging costs under stated annual mileage, local electricity prices, and home/public charging mixes?
acceptance_criteria: home and public charging cost scenarios

objectives.question: What scheduled maintenance, common repairs, and model-year-specific known issues should buyers expect?
acceptance_criteria: maintenance or repair evidence tied to model/year

objectives.question: What recalls, warranty terms, and battery coverage apply to the compared model years and trims?
What is the estimated 5- and 10-year total ownership cost, with assumptions and sensitivity ranges, for each compared EV?
acceptance_criteria: maintenance, insurance, taxes/fees, depreciation, and financing assumptions

objectives.question: Which EVs are conditionally best for efficiency, affordability, low ownership cost, and reliability, and what evidence remains insufficient?
acceptance_criteria: explicit counterevidence, uncertainties, and unresolved objectives
